task: Prevent unreachable handler and command surfaces from silently accumulating while retiring only proven legacy residue.
outcome: After completion, running npm run test:orphan-surface prints orphan surface verification passed, npm --prefix packages/main run build succeeds, and lattice implementation_review_result_get --help still reports unknown command instead of reviving the old unsigned review path.
facts: implementation_review_result_set/get are defined in a handler file but are not registered in the current CLI registry or command catalog.
Current REVIEW evidence is signed through review_run_start plus finding_add or review_pass_set, so the old implementation-review command path is not the correct modern lane.
core/intent-coverage.ts was previously deleted by B-76a3 and was reintroduced by a baseline import without live imports.

run-all-smokes discovers tasks/*-smoke.js dynamically, so task files must not be treated as orphan merely because package.json does not list each one.
constraints: Do not register legacy commands merely to satisfy a detector.
Do not delete dynamic serve, devHost, browser bridge, or smoke discovery entrypoints.
Keep the detector narrow enough to catch real command/handler correctness drift without becoming a broad dead-code optimizer.
